_comment: Single source of truth for the framework vocabulary (PU tiers, backends, app stage counts). Codegen -> platform/vocab/generated/bt_vocab.hpp (C++) + optimizer/smt/bt_vocab.py (Python) via scripts/embed_vocab.py. Encodes the CURRENT values verbatim; behavior-preserving (the orphaned 'super' tier stays out of the solver's tier list exactly as today -- see docs/reports-for-human/target-structure.md P4).
_app_stages_comment: Stage counts of the CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED kernels: tree = the 7-stage octree pipeline; cifar-dense/cifar-sparse = the 9-stage SmallAlexNet. The canonical AlexNetCIFAR spec (docs/instruction-for-ai/04) is 11 stages -- the C++ kernels are not migrated to it yet, so 9 is correct here today.
